description: Etsy Product Research: etsy/product Query API.

beginFavorites.description: The number of favorites (starting), together with the ending value, form the upstream favorites

beginFavoritesWeekly.description: Number of new favorites per week (start), which together with the end value form the upstream favorites_weekly

beginPrice.description: Price (start), together with the end price, form the upstream price (such as 20~100); when filling in only one side, the upstream is start~ or ~end

beginReviews.description: The number of reviews (starting), which together with the end value form the upstream reviews

beginReviewsWeekly.description: Number of new comments per week (start), which together with the end value form the upstream reviews_weekly

beginSales.description: Total sales (starting), which together with the ending value form the upstream sales

beginSalesWeekly.description: Weekly sales volume (start), together with the end value, form the upstream sales_weekly (such as 1~100)

category.description: Product classification ID (single product category), please see the product classification interface for details

endFavoritesWeekly.description: Number of new favorites per week (end)

endPrice.description: Price (end), which together with the starting price forms the upstream price

endReviewsWeekly.description: Number of new comments per week (end)

listedTime.description: The shelf time is no earlier than this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

pageSize.description: Number of entries per page, maximum 100, recommended not to exceed 50

searchKey.description: Search keywords or Etsy product URLs

sortBy.description: Sorting field (corresponding to upstream sort_by, value 1~6)

sortDesc.description: Sorting direction (corresponds to upstream `desc`). Schema example: Descending `1`, Ascending `2`

status.description: Product status (example: 1 on the shelves, 0 off the shelves)
